compatibility_review.Cadra: New mandatory ready_scope/scheduler and group state semantics use protocol 0.11; execution does not accept 0.10, only list reads it without migration. Package minor increment is appropriate for pre-1.0 incompatible protocol changes.
compatibility_review.Cohestra: New stage-local orchestration waits and process delivery require a minor package increment; formal control contract remains 0.8 with unchanged fields/enums.
compatibility_review.other_skills: Full-suite and version-history checks pass for unchanged Vistra and Relatra.

before_publication: Include all 5 new package files and accompanying tests/docs; omitting untracked modules would break the package.

Recommended: accept an isolated real-host run with both 0.14 packages loaded, disjoint fixed grouping, original-role resource waiting/resume and group closure. Current installed copies are older; no such new-host execution was performed in this check.
Publish the two compatible package candidates together; confirm public files/versions after publishing before deploying the new website copy.
local_upgrade_boundary: Before replacing a 0.10 Cadra environment, close old runs in their original environment, back up/archive unchanged records, and re-prepare remaining work. This check did not inspect or operate any business queue.
environment_notes: Default Python lacked PyYAML for the optional system skill-format validator. Validation passed using an isolated uv environment with PyYAML; no global Python packages or skill dependencies were changed.
limits: No installer invocation, real child-agent run or business queue execution.
No source edits, staging, commit, push, tag, GitHub Release or website deployment.
Offline tests use actual shipped reducer/guard with synthetic host observations; they do not establish real host execution behavior.
